angu_guide.text: Wallblake House was built about 1787 and is the oldest surviving plantation house on the island. It's a handsome building with an ugly history, and we try to tell both.
The estate was worked by enslaved people. After emancipation in 1834 the island, with little good land, turned to fishing, salt and boat building.

angu_cook.text: The kitchen's out in the yard, away from the house, because of fire and heat. The cistern collected rain. It had to. Anguilla has no rivers.
Anguilla's dry, flat and low. Every drop of rain was precious.
